posts.title: Prepping my AI PC
posts.description: I’ve been building an AI PC for myself as part of the preparation for a series of courses on Pluralsight focusing on running Small Language Models. Local AI is an area that I’ve wanted to dig into for a while, and building a course for others is a great way to force myself to learn. It’s also a fantastic excuse to spend money on hardware - like I needed one.
